statements.text:
A thoughtful piece from my colleague @Rep_Whitesides, who brings a unique perspective to the debate over AI after serving as NASA’s Chief of Staff and spending much of his career in aerospace.

AI has enormous potential, but moving fast shouldn’t mean ignoring serious risks. George makes a compelling case for borrowing a lesson from aerospace: when the stakes are high, taking the time to understand the risks and put the right safeguards in place is just common sense.

Worth a read.
https://t.co/orGkbxJmpO

I tend to think that if we look at our history, you find very few examples in history of banning things working out. But it is important to have regulations and rules and make sure that things are working well for people. And there's a lot of concern out there. I think it'd be irresponsible of Congress not to take that seriously.
